topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the framework of cancer evolution, and defines the learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations drive clonal selection and malignant transformation.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of tissue hierarchy, the cell of origin, and cancer stem cell models in tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Influences and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how microenvironmental factors, inflammatory signals, and stromal interactions promote tumor initiation and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Research Methodologies and Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics present the experimental technologies used to map tumor-microenvironment dynamics and synthesize the multifactorial evolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Closing and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
